description: Post-optimization projected/expected improvements with Redis cache, gzip compression, slimmer queries, and cursor pagination

improvements: Redis cache-aside: sports/categories/products/courts/analytics (60-95% faster on warm cache)
Gzip compression: ~60-70% smaller JSON payloads over the wire
Booking reminders: single bulk dedupe query vs N findFirst
Notification delivery: single findMany vs per-channel findFirst
Admin broadcast: batched parallel creates (50 concurrent) vs sequential
Cursor pagination: no COUNT(*) on infinite-scroll endpoints
CDN image URLs: WebP transforms via CDN_BASE_URL query params
